topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I keep seeing this expensive car pulling into the driveway next door, and it doesn't quite fit the image of Mr. Thompson, the man who always waves with a smile, chats about his garden, and seems to live a modest life. Maybe it's a rental, or maybe he's just good at keeping secrets. I find myself glancing over more often, trying to catch a glimpse of what could be going on behind those familiar curtains. It's hard not to wonder what else I've overlooked in the person I thought I knew well. The thought makes me fiddle with the edges of my sleeve, contemplating how I might bring it up the next time I see him, if I do.
